n6089d875f9.headline: European Central Bank surprises with broad stimulus action
n6089d875f9.summary: The European Central Bank introduced an unexpectedly broad array of stimulus actions aimed at supporting modest economic recovery in the 19 eurozone countries.
n6089d875f9.why: The ECB is the central bank for the eurozone, and its monetary policy decisions significantly influence economic growth, inflation, and financial markets across Europe.
n6089d875f9.why_moved: ECB stimulus measures typically affect eurozone bond yields, the euro currency, and European equity markets by signaling monetary easing.
